_comment: Option flags FileMaker draws bare, measured on FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 (macOS, 2026-10-19): each step was pasted into a script with its flags set as listed, FileMaker's displayed line read, and the step copied back (xml). FileMaker Pro 19.6.3 and 22.0.4 draw the same lines for the default-state steps.

Get Folder Path's Allow Folder Creation, Add Account's and Reset Account Password's Expire password, Go to List of Records' New window, Convert File's Skip Indexes and Show/Hide Toolbars' Include Edit Record Toolbar and Lock are drawn only when on. Convert File's Open File is drawn only when Option is False.
flags: the state FileMaker stored for each element the case covers.
